sloka: आत्मनः सदृशं वीरः स तं निक्षिप्य वानरम्।सुग्रीवो ऽभिमुखः शत्रुं प्रतस्थे पादपायुधः ।। ६.९७.७ ।।
transliteration: ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṁ vīraḥ sa taṁ nikṣipya vānaram।sugrīvo 'bhimukhaḥ śatruṁ pratasthe pādapāyudhaḥ ।। 6.97.7 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, being a hero himself, uprooting a tree as a weapon, went towards the enemy after having assigned Sushena the responsibility of protection of Vanaras.
